checks.message: Site boundary is declared provisional_constraint with official_boundary=false; replace with the official redline before professional scoring.
Three required key areas are present and flagged provisional; announced areas (192.1 / 104.3 / 72.0 ha) are used for content, not the provisional rectangles.
30 land-use polygons fully partition the site with no overlap; residual coverage gap is below the 0.01% topology tolerance.
site_area_sqm, green_ratio and public_space_ratio are recomputed in EPSG:4548 from the submitted layers and match spatial review.
Buildings, green space, public space and scenario nodes are contained by the submitted site boundary.
Static offline HTML visualisation: no remote scripts, tiles, fonts, iframes, forms or trackers.
Chinese primary text plus English counterparts for the proposal, report, visual page, A3/A0 drawings and all five figures.
Every required chapter carries at least one relevant evidence marker; complete indexes stay in the machine-audit files.
All figures, drawings and HTML are agent-generated from the site package; no third-party imagery, fonts, logos or portraits are embedded.
Announcement tasks 1.3.x / 1.4.x / 1.5.x and agent.1–agent.6 each map to chapters, layers, metrics, drawings and visual sections.
Provisional geometry, pending statutory controls and recalculation triggers are disclosed as 11 assumptions.
